qaEntry.chatGptNotes: Content and umlaut checks approved from accepted review ledger mathematik-batch-141.md (accepted_pilot_after_regeneration). Review note: The accepted image lists `T_0(x)=1`, `T_1(x)=1+x`, `T_2(x)=1+x+x^2/2`, and `T_3(x)=1+x+x^2/2+x^3/6`. The value check at `x=1` correctly shows `e^1≈2.718`, `T_0(1)=1`, `T_1(1)=2`, `T_2(1)=2.5`, and `T_3(1)≈2.667`. The graph marks the shared point `P(0|1)` on `T_0(x)=1`, not on the x-axis.
qaEntry.aiNotes: Fresh full-resolution review: T0 through T3 are the correct Maclaurin polynomials for e^x. Their values 1,2,2.5,2.667 at x=1 approach e≈2.718, and the graph correctly communicates improving local approximation near x=0.
